auth.label: Client Token
auth.description: Z-API account security token. Create it from https://developer.z-api.io/en/security/client-token.

actions.name: get_instance_status
actions.description: Check whether the Z-API instance and its connected smartphone are online.

inputSchema.description: No input is required to check the configured instance status.

connected.description: Whether the WhatsApp account is connected to Z-API.

error.description: The current connection status detail returned by Z-API.

smartphoneConnected.description: Whether the connected smartphone is online.

outputSchema.description: The current Z-API instance connection status.

actions.name: send_image
actions.description: Send an image from a public URL to a WhatsApp contact or group through Z-API.

phone.description: The recipient phone number with country and area codes, or a Z-API group ID.

imageUrl.description: The public HTTP or HTTPS image URL that Z-API should fetch and send.

caption.description: The caption to send with the image.

messageId.description: The message ID to reply to.

delayMessage.description: The delay before sending the message, in seconds.

viewOnce.description: Whether the image can be viewed only once.

editImageMessageId.description: The ID of a previously sent image message whose caption should be edited.

inputSchema.description: The URL-backed image message to send.

id.description: The Zapier-compatible alias of the WhatsApp message ID.

outputSchema.description: Identifiers for the message accepted by Z-API.

actions.name: send_location
actions.description: Send a fixed location to a WhatsApp contact or group through Z-API.

phone.description: The recipient phone number with country and area codes, or a Z-API group ID.

address.description: The full street address for the location.

latitude.description: The location latitude as a decimal string.

longitude.description: The location longitude as a decimal string.

messageId.description: The message ID to reply to.

delayMessage.description: The delay before sending the message, in seconds.

inputSchema.description: The fixed location message to send.

id.description: The Zapier-compatible alias of the WhatsApp message ID.

outputSchema.description: Identifiers for the message accepted by Z-API.

actions.name: send_text
actions.description: Send a plain-text message to a WhatsApp contact or group through Z-API.

phone.description: The recipient phone number with country and area codes, or a Z-API group ID.

delayMessage.description: The delay before sending the message, in seconds.

delayTyping.description: How long to show the typing status before sending, in seconds.

editMessageId.description: The ID of a previously sent text message to edit.

id.description: The Zapier-compatible alias of the WhatsApp message ID.

outputSchema.description: Identifiers for the message accepted by Z-API.
